description: This Dart source file defines providers, classes, and methods related to quiz analytics in a Flutter app using Riverpod. It manages state, filters, and calculations for quiz attempts, KPIs, categories, and analytics exporting.

classes.name: AnalyticsFilter
classes.description: Represents filter criteria for analytics, including date range and optional category.

classes.name: QuizKpis
classes.description: Holds key performance indicators such as total attempts, average score, best score, completion rate, and recent attempts count.

classes.name: PerQuizStat
classes.description: Holds statistics per quiz, including attempts, scores, and completion status.

classes.name: QuizAnalytics
classes.description: Encapsulates overall analytics data including KPIs and per-quiz statistics.

classes.name: AnalyticsFilterNotifier
classes.description: Notifier class managing state of the current analytics filter.

classes.name: QuizAnalyticsRefresher
classes.description: Notifier to trigger refresh of analytics data.

methods.name: _startOfDay
methods.description: Static method to get the start of the day (UTC) for a DateTime.

methods.name: _endOfDay
methods.description: Static method to get the end of the day (UTC) for a DateTime.
